purpose: Resolve the original uniform-allocation question with fixed Richardson validation; inspect oracle integer allocation separately.
claim_boundary: This config declares a post-hoc Q18-S1 successor after the original ratios and Hubbard step sweep were inspected. It carries no successor execution result. The uniform statistic, grouping, bank set and tenfold bar remain those of Q18. The derivative check uses a fixed step ladder and both final Richardson pairs. Integer allocation is an exact-oracle diagnostic that charges an unperformed pilot, permits no estimator implementation and supplies no finite-sample evidence.
question: On each of the five licensed banks, does estimating the ground Ritz root's residual norm sigma from shared QWC word means, to the same standard error as its energy, cost at most ten times the energy's shots?

estimand.root: the ground root of the retained block's (S, H) pencil, solved by the package's default thresholds, normalized c'Sc = 1
estimand.variance: sigma^2 = c'Kc - E^2, with K the SecondMomentBank block A_i^dagger (H^2 A_j) paired with the reference. It equals ||(H - E)|Psi>||^2 / <Psi|Psi>, the squared residual norm PLAN.md section 4.4 names
estimand.residual_norm: sigma = sqrt(sigma^2), in the energy's own units: Weinstein's theorem puts an eigenvalue within sigma of E, so (E, sigma) is the measured pair a residual reports
estimand.estimator: every S, H and K entry is reconstructed from one set of shared word means; the measured pencil is solved and sigma^2 read from the measured K at the measured Ritz vector. Nothing is re-measured per entry
estimand.shift: Measuring (H - c)^2 instead of H^2 changes nothing here. Its rows are combinations of the same S, H and K rows, so with shared word means the reconstruction is algebraically the same function of the same means, and so is its linearization. The gate's tests check this to rounding on the Hubbard dimer

linearization.energy: the existing ritz_functional: the word expansion of B'(H - E)B with B = sum c_i A_i. The energy is stationary in c, so no Ritz-vector term enters
linearization.residual: the word expansion of G = B'(H - E)^2 B - sigma^2 B'B - [V'(H - E)B + B'(H - E)V], with V = sum v_i A_i and v = sum_{k>0} c_k (c_k'(K - QS)c) / (E_k - E), Q = c'Kc. sigma^2 is not stationary in c, so the last term, the Ritz vector's own movement, is required: on the Hubbard dimer it is 3.7% of the weights
linearization.implementation: residual_functional in benchmarks/check_phase15_measured_residual_preregistration.py, which the producer imports rather than restates
linearization.properties: G has zero reference expectation, and its weights are invariant under a constant shift of H; both are deterministic checks

direction_definitions.functional: the residual functional's own non-identity weights, normalized to unit length: the derivative along it is ||g||_2
direction_definitions.sh_gaussian: a seeded standard normal draw over the non-identity (S, H) words, normalized: those words carry the Ritz-vector term

finite_difference.rounding_floor: RESOLUTION * cancellation_scale / step, with RESOLUTION = 1e-12 from clifford_qc.subspace.second_moment and the cancellation scale the validation record's
finite_difference.rule: |central difference of the nonlinear pipeline - g . d| <= relative_tolerance * ||g||_2 + rounding_floor, for both directions
finite_difference.calibration: On the undeclared Hubbard dimer the step leaves the truncation error near 5e-9 of ||g||_2, with and without a -75 Ha constant added to H to reproduce H2O's cancellation scale. A dropped Ritz-vector term fails it by orders of magnitude

grouping.energy_universe: the measured (S, H) universe: the raw U_SH, the (S, H) bank's words over the retained block, minus the identity, listed in ascending code order exactly as the mapping-axis producer lists its JW arm
grouping.residual_universe: the measured combined universe: the raw U = U_SH | U_K minus the identity. The raw U is every word a measured second-moment bank's rows carry, and the H-squared preflight record committed its size and SHA-256
grouping.universe_convention: Raw universes include the identity, as the Phase 2M-A ledger, the H-squared preflight record and the mapping-axis record count and hash them; every frozen basis starts with I, so S_00 carries it. Measured universes are the raw ones minus the identity, whose mean is 1 and is never measured. Every count and digest in measured_before_freezing whose name starts with raw_ is a raw quantity; measured_sh_words and measured_combined_words are one fewer, and every grouping partitions a measured universe
grouping.rationale: The declared protocol is the mapping-axis record's, per system, so the energy denominator reproduces a committed setting count. On the 8-qubit banks the greedy and the scalable cover are both feasible, and a status must not rest on one heuristic. On H2O the greedy is quadratic in 868,150 words, so the cover is the only protocol and no alternative is declared
grouping.variance: per setting, Var_psi(sum_{w in g} f_w P_w) on the exact reference, by run_mapping_axis._functional_variance, the function behind the committed mapping-axis energy variances. V is their sum: the estimator's variance at one shot per setting

statistic.name: R
statistic.derivation: Uniform shots make a linearized estimator's variance V / N at N shots per setting, so a standard error s costs G * V / s^2 shots. sigma is read from sigma^2 through d sigma = d sigma^2 / (2 sigma). Matching the two standard errors at s, the s^2 cancels: R is the residual's shots over the energy's at any one matched precision, to first order
statistic.rationale: A decade is the unit this repository reads as material, as in Q16's word clause and Phase 16B's 10x modelled-shot rule. A residual within a decade of its energy's shots is a by-product of measuring that energy well; beyond it, it is a measurement of its own. A ratio exactly at ten is affordable
statistic.matched_precision: Matching the standard errors of E and sigma makes both ends of the measured Weinstein interval [E - sigma, E + sigma] carry the two sources equally
statistic.linear_regime: d sigma = d sigma^2 / (2 sigma) holds while the standard error of sigma^2 is small against sigma^2. At a matched precision s that error is 2 sigma s, so the record reports matched_precision_half = sigma / 4, the s at which it reaches one half of sigma^2. Finer precisions are where R describes the cost; coarser ones do not resolve sigma from zero. No clause reads it
statistic.diagnostics: the record also reports the Neyman ratio, both sides at variance-optimal allocation across settings, (sum_g sqrt v_g)^2 in place of G * V. No clause reads it

bank_status_order.condition: R <= 10 under the declared protocol, and under the alternative where one is declared
R > 10 under the declared protocol, and under the alternative where one is declared
the declared and alternative protocols put R on opposite sides of 10

decision_rule.invalid_precedence: A failed deterministic check makes that bank INVALID, and any INVALID bank makes the verdict INVALID.
decision_rule.combination_rule: every bank AFFORDABLE gives FULL; no bank AFFORDABLE gives NONE; anything else is RESTRICTED; any INVALID bank gives INVALID

consequences.FULL: Post-hoc under the original uniform protocol only. Phase 15 builds the finite-shot estimator of the second-moment block on all five banks: sampled K over the declared grouping, and sigma with a delta-method interval labelled asymptotic and cross-checked by the grouped bootstrap. Its sampled validation is a new preregistration that freezes seeds, budgets and coverage targets. This verdict licenses building it, not any sampled claim.
consequences.RESTRICTED: Post-hoc under the original uniform protocol only. The estimator is built and validated only on the AFFORDABLE banks, which become its scope by name. Residuals elsewhere stay exact or matrix-free, and extending the measured estimator to them needs a new declaration.
consequences.NONE: Post-hoc uniform-only closure: no finite-shot second-moment estimator under uniform QWC on these five banks. Exact residuals and convergence reporting remain available. Oracle allocation diagnostics do not close or license another allocation protocol.
consequences.INVALID: Post-hoc under the original uniform protocol only. No verdict. The record names the failed check, and no status is read from that run.

banks.basis: Each bank at its frozen selected_labels, through the same _build_model and _selected_generators the mapping-axis record, both Phase 2M records and both Phase 15 records use. They are the five banks the H-squared preflight licensed and the SecondMomentBank validation covers.
banks.not_declared: Every bank outside the five, including the 14-qubit molecular banks, which the H-squared preflight left to the Phase 2M storage gate or a preflight of their own.

deterministic_checks: baseline_matches_freeze: every measured_before_freezing value recomputes at execution, and every premise flag in it holds

combined_universe_matches_preflight: the raw U, rebuilt as U_SH | U_K from SecondMomentBank rows, has the committed size and SHA-256, and contains the identity; the measured U is that set minus the identity
energy_settings_reproduce_mapping_axis: G_SH under the declared protocol equals the mapping-axis JW arm's committed settings
energy_variance_reproduces_mapping_axis: where the mapping-axis record committed V_E (h4_converged, beh2), the recomputed V_E equals it within 1e-9 relative

partitions_valid: each grouping assigns every word of its measured universe to exactly one setting, so the energy partition holds raw_sh_word_universe - 1 words and the residual partition raw_combined_word_universe - 1, and every setting is qubit-wise commuting
residual_functional_reproduces_variance: the residual pipeline at the exact means returns the validation record's sigma^2 within 1e-9 (1 + cancellation_scale) absolute
linearization_matches_finite_differences: both frozen directions pass the finite-difference rule
group_variances_nonnegative: every per-setting variance is at least -1e-10 times its scale
provenance: the record is stamped with a clean git tree

evidence.label: asymptotic
evidence.statement: First-order (delta-method) variances at large shot counts, computed exactly from the reference state and the frozen bases. No sampling, no seed beyond the finite-difference direction, no finite-sample statement.

excluded_from_cost: fully commuting or block-commuting grouping, which would change both sides and is not priced here
variance-optimal allocation, reported only as the Neyman diagnostic
device-card time: QWC settings carry single-qubit rotations only, so the cards would differ only by per-setting single-qubit depth and readout, and the record prices shots
the plug-in bias of sigma^2 and every second-order effect, including the retained eigenspace's nonlinear response
finite-sample intervals, bootstrap coverage and sampled validation
excited roots, folded-spectrum roots and every bank outside the five
exploratory_disclosure: All predecessor ratios and the Hubbard step sweep were inspected. The successor is post_hoc on the original five banks.

prespecified_followup.statement: The estimand, linearization, grouping protocols, threshold and banks are fixed. Another threshold, protocol, allocation or bank set would be a new declaration. The consequence each verdict names is what follows.

implementation_lineage.note: Inputs stay bound for the life of the record. The product, the bank, the second-moment rows, the projected solve, the QWC partitions, the energy functional, the group variance, the bank builder and this declaration's own gate, whose residual_functional and finite-difference rule the producer imports, define every number the ratio reads. They are bound until the record exists; after that the record's provenance names the commit that produced it.

must_include: per bank: the raw and measured sizes of both universes, and the raw combined SHA-256
per bank and protocol: G_SH, V_E, G_U, V_sigma2, R and the Neyman ratio
per bank: sigma, matched_precision_half, the functional's word count and ||g||_2, and both finite-difference rows
per bank: every deterministic check and its value
per-bank status and the verdict, with the verdict's consequence quoted

revisions.changes: Separate successor after the original INVALID record; original declaration and record are immutable. No successor execution is present.
Correct record_requirements artifact paths after execution; measurements and execution provenance are unchanged.

successor.disclosure: The original ratios, Neyman diagnostics and six-step Hubbard truncation sweep were seen before this declaration. Its commit order protects identity only; it is not preregistration against these banks.

derivative_validation.rule: Evaluate all four central differences. Richardson R(h)=(4 D(h/2)-D(h))/3. Both final pairs must match the analytic derivative within relative_tolerance*||g|| + propagated RESOLUTION*cancellation_scale/h; they must also agree within the relative term plus both propagated floors. Every endpoint retains full rank and the declared nondegenerate ground root. No step is selected based on its discrepancy.

allocation_diagnostic.rule: Allocate ceil(sqrt(v_g)*sum sqrt(v)/s^2), with a positive floor on every setting. Energy and sigma use one matched s=sigma/100. Charge 64 pilot shots per setting on each side; exclude pilot outcomes from production. Variances are exact and no pilot is performed. This is neither a realizable pilot protocol nor an estimator licence.
